data.text: Luke, keeping the total at 50 tons makes sense, but why should you get 14 while everyone else gets 9? I learned to fish here with my family, and I want this lake to keep supporting all our families. I propose 10 tons each: equal income of $10,000 and enough fish left to restore the lake next month. We can check the revealed catches afterward and keep that agreement going. John, would you support an equal split?
